The '''Nineteenth Army''', also known as '''Dark Saber Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Javin Oversector]]. It was commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sulamar (Moff)|Sulamar]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the 19th Sector Army fought in a number of battles against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] while the latter [[Yag'Dhul theater|advanced]] from [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] to [[Bomis Koori IV]] along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. Ultimately, the Sector Army managed to retain control of [[Kriselist/Legends|Kriselist]], which sat at the [[Kriselist junction|junction]] between the Corellian Trade Spine and the [[D'Aelgoth Trade Route]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
